messages:
maria: Heads-up: starter-edge fails under NodeNext/TS5 with overload ambiguity when using our ESM SDK entrypoint.

devin: Can you paste the minimal import + call?

maria: import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'; const c = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RI_KEY }); await c.chat.create({ model: 'r-instruct', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hey'}] });

elaine: error?

maria: TS complains: "Overload resolution failed: generic constraint 'T extends Record<string, unknown>' not satisfied" when resolving ChatCreateParams. Only happens with moduleResolution: 'nodeNext' or 'bundler' in Vite. CJS consumers fine.

devin: Sounds like declaration file picked has ambiguous overloads. We changed types recently to add non-generic fallback which may be the culprit. Bundlers pick different .d.ts depending on exports/types.

elaine: quick fixes: 1) emit an ESM-specific d.ts under exports.types for the import path, 2) collapse duplicate overloads into a single generic signature with unknown defaults, 3) add starter tsconfig note to use bundler resolution for Vite.

maria: can someone make a tiny PR that adds an "exports.types" pointer and a shim d.ts? New hires are blocked on the bootcamp.

devin: I'll open a draft PR, include a small repro and CI job that compiles the starter with TS 5.x + nodeNext. tag: devex/types.

typebot: CI alert: nightly-starter failed: TS compile error in starter-edge. job: 1023.

elaine: also add `skipLibCheck` as a temporary note in README. We'll follow up with linter to catch ambiguous overload groups in codegen.

maria: thanks everyone, please post PR link here. :pray:
